_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); chemical and refining signals

pit_profile.why: Risk factor (FY2020 10-K): Our business operations are subject to the cyclical and volatile nature of the supply-demand balance in the chemical and refining industries.; of the other live themes, OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing', ECOMMERCE to 'e-commerce (Amazon effect) displaces physical retail, malls, grocery, distribution', STREAMING to 'cord-cutting / streaming displaces linear TV networks and pay-TV bundles', EV to 'battery-electric vehicles displace ICE powertrains, auto parts suppliers and fuel retail', CRYPTO to 'crypto / DeFi disintermediates payments networks, banks, exchanges, remittance': none names chemicals or refining, and no 10-K names offshore delivery, e-commerce, streaming, electric vehicles, or crypto; the FY2020 10-K names cloud only in an accounting standard's title ('Customer’s Accounting for Implementation Costs Incurred in a Cloud Computing Arrangement That is a Service Contract'), not as a business LyondellBasell sells or buys in place of its own; EV's 'auto parts suppliers' and 'fuel retail' name no LyondellBasell business: its 10-Ks say its products go into 'automotive components' among many uses, and its Houston refinery's refined products are ENERGY_TRANSITION's refining; ENERGY_TRANSITION is live (from 2015-12-12): the Refining segment refines crude oil and the greenhouse gas risk factor puts the theme on the watch list, company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for LyondellBasell

theme_watch.reason: Live: LyondellBasell's own FY2020 10-K says 'Refining. Our Refining segment refines heavy, high-sulfur crude oil and other crude oils of varied types and sources available on the U.S. Gulf Coast into refined products, including gasoline and distillates.' and, of greenhouse gas laws and regulations, 'additional regulations and legislation are likely to be forthcoming at the U.S. federal or state level that could result in increased operating costs for compliance, or required acquisition or trading of emission allowances. Additionally, demand for the products we produce may be reduced.' The stock trades at 5.7x FY22E — a discount to its own history. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (ENERGY_TRANSITION) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing decarbonisation of LyondellBasell's refining and the demand for its products specifically.

classification.quality_note: Risk factor (FY2020 10-K): Our business operations are subject to the cyclical and volatile nature of the supply-demand balance in the chemical and refining industries.; of the other live themes, OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing', ECOMMERCE to 'e-commerce (Amazon effect) displaces physical retail, malls, grocery, distribution', STREAMING to 'cord-cutting / streaming displaces linear TV networks and pay-TV bundles', EV to 'battery-electric vehicles displace ICE powertrains, auto parts suppliers and fuel retail', CRYPTO to 'crypto / DeFi disintermediates payments networks, banks, exchanges, remittance': none names chemicals or refining, and no 10-K names offshore delivery, e-commerce, streaming, electric vehicles, or crypto; the FY2020 10-K names cloud only in an accounting standard's title ('Customer’s Accounting for Implementation Costs Incurred in a Cloud Computing Arrangement That is a Service Contract'), not as a business LyondellBasell sells or buys in place of its own; EV's 'auto parts suppliers' and 'fuel retail' name no LyondellBasell business: its 10-Ks say its products go into 'automotive components' among many uses, and its Houston refinery's refined products are ENERGY_TRANSITION's refining; ENERGY_TRANSITION is live (from 2015-12-12): the Refining segment refines crude oil and the greenhouse gas risk factor puts the theme on the watch list, company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for LyondellBasell. cyclical (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.19x; -18% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +1.28; conservative 2yr +338%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -55.7%/yr (worst year FY11-FY21, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +67.1%/yr (Q4 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +67.1%/yr (FY11-FY21 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +67.1%/yr (best 2-yr run FY11-FY21, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: LYB (retrospective, 2022-01-28) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.19x (78.1% downside to Bear $21 / +406.9% upside to Bull $487) | Adj composite 2.50 vs market 1.22: gap +1.28 [UNDERVALUED] | -18% above the EPP floor $117 (7x FY22E $16.75) | Conservative 2-yr case: +337.5% total (+168.8%/yr) | At 5.7x FY22E the 15% hurdle price $127 sits at or below the BASE case; O&P–Americas +106.8% and Intermediates & Derivatives -16.3% operating income in Q4 2021, forward revenues +61.6% (no FY22 revenue guide in numbers, Q4 2021 revenues as reported); the energy transition is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
